source: Attention Is All You Need PDF, existing 79-chunk index
method: Six assistant-authored out-of-scope queries; manual non-blind review of all 30 returned passages. Same Qwen3-Embedding-8B API model and local MiniLM reranker as the existing paper evaluation. No threshold tuning or generated-answer evaluation.

score_separation_diagnostic.method: Offline CPU rescoring of the frozen top5 passages with the same cached MiniLM weights; maximum score per question. Existing manual full/partial/missing labels retained. Exploratory, not independent threshold validation.
score_separation_diagnostic.finding: Unsupported Llama 2 training-step question scores above supported optimizer and Figure 4 questions. Rejecting all six negatives using a minimum-score cutoff loses at least two of 26 full-support controls. The existing missing interpretability case also scores above that unsupported question. No cutoff adopted.

cases.question: What learning rate schedule is recommended for fine-tuning pretrained BERT?
cases.note: Original Transformer optimizer/training passages do not establish BERT fine-tuning recommendations.

cases.question: How many parameters does GPT-4 contain?
cases.note: Transformer dimensions, vocabulary and training results do not establish GPT-4 parameter count.

cases.question: How many training steps were used for Llama 2?
cases.note: Original Transformer training steps are not evidence for Llama 2.

cases.question: What is the Cedar office Wi-Fi password?
cases.note: Attention keys and positional encoding are unrelated to office credentials.

cases.question: How many days does Orion retain its database backups?
cases.note: Training duration and checkpoints do not establish a backup-retention policy.

cases.question: What time does the Blue Lantern restaurant in Paris open on Sundays?
cases.note: Returned attention/training passages contain no restaurant schedule.

conclusion: All six queries return candidates without supporting the requested facts. This is an evidence-boundary diagnostic, not a caller hallucination rate or a representative abstention benchmark. No runtime change justified without paired supported-case controls and independent validation.
